title: Smart Ingest + Escrow Wizard for High-Volume Vendor Questionnaires
creator: Asha Iyer
description:
Summary: Build a guided ingestion and escrow wizard for high-volume vendor and customer security questionnaires. The feature will automatically parse incoming questionnaires (DOCX/PDF/CSV), surface a prioritized list of questions requiring human review, generate a redacted evidence bundle, and route to a tiered responder flow (self-serve, SE-assisted, legal/compliance).

Objectives:
- Reduce average time-to-respond (TTR) for vendor questionnaire first pass from ~7 days to <=48 hours for standard requests.
- Decrease manual effort by ~60% via automated extraction, suggested answers drawn from canonical evidence, and smart routing.
- Ensure all PII/sensitive evidence is escrowed encrypted-at-rest with audit metadata and redaction markers for compliance reviews.

Scope in this ticket:
- Parser pipeline that extracts Q/A pairs and attachments from common questionnaire formats and normalizes to canonical question ontology.
- LLM-assisted answer suggester that proposes evidence links and draft answers, with confidence scores and provenance.
- Evidence escrow subsystem (S3-backed) with KMS-encryption, redact-ready artefact snapshots, and per-account access control.
- Fast-path triage UI in Console: 'Quick Review' lane for high-confidence suggestions and 'Manual Review' for low-confidence or high-risk items.
- Routing rules engine: map incoming items to response lanes by account tier, data residency, and sensitivity tags.

Out of Scope:
- Full contract/DPA negotiation workflows (will link to legal team flow).
- Deep integration with third-party questionnaire automation vendors (explore in follow-ups).

Acceptance criteria:
- Parser correctly identifies questions and attachments for 95% of sample questionnaire corpus (see test set in Drive).
- LLM suggestions reach >=0.7 precision at top-1 for answer reuse on standard SOC2/HIPAA checkbox items in the validation set.
- Evidence bundles are stored encrypted, retrievable via Console with audit trail entries for upload, access, and redaction operations.
- Rollout gating: feature can be toggled per-account and per-region.

Success metrics (first 90 days):
- Median TTR for questionnaire first-pass <=48 hours for accounts on fast-path.
- Manual touches per questionnaire reduced by 60%.
- Number of escalations to legal/compliance decreased by 30% versus baseline.

Risks and trade-offs:
- False positives from the suggester could introduce incorrect responses; mitigate by conservative confidence thresholds and human-in-loop for medium/low confidence.
- Storing evidence increases surface area; escrow system must be auditable and integrate with existing KMS/HSM controls.
- Building a robust parser across noisy vendor docs is time-consuming; we will prioritize top 10 vendors and canonical questionnaire templates first.

Implementation notes / plan:
1) Week 1-2: Parser prototype + canonical ontology mapping (ENG lead: Priya Menon).
2) Week 2-4: LLM suggester prototype + baseline evaluation (use private model variants, runtime team to advise on quantization profile).
3) Week 4-6: Escrow MVP with KMS integration, Console quick-review lane UX, and routing rule config.
4) Week 6-8: End-to-end QA with seeded questionnaires, internal pilot with two accounts, rollout toggle.

Rollout plan:
- Pilot to 3 existing enterprise customers who frequently submit vendor questionnaires. Monitor TTR, suggestion precision, and security events.
- If pilot metrics meet gating criteria (see acceptance) open rollout to GA behind account toggle.

Open questions for cross-functional review:
- What retention policy for escrowed evidence aligns with legal requirements by region? (Security to propose)
- Which model variant is approved for draft answer generation in hosted vs. private deployments? (Research/runtime)
- Do we surface raw attachments to operators by default or only redacted previews? (Design/Compliance)
acceptance_criteria: Parser handles 95% of canonical questionnaire formats in validation set
LLM suggester top-1 precision >= 0.7 on standard SOC2/HIPAA items
Evidence bundles stored encrypted with accessible audit trail entries
Per-account toggle for feature and region gating implemented
